summary: Lookout site in Bledsoe County, TN. A 2014 National Register table lists it as still standing; Tennessee Landforms marks it historical. No build or staffing record found.

notes_for_editor: Status conflict: Tennessee Landforms (revised 2026-01-08) marks Meyers historical; the 2014 NRHP table of extant TDF towers lists it. No build date, staffing or fire record found. Forest Lookouts lists Meyers in Bledsoe County with no status; its per-tower page (easternuslookouts.weebly.com/meyers.html) returned 404. The Bledsoe State Forest page (tn.gov) says fire towers on state forests are not open to the public and may not be climbed, but no source ties Meyers to that forest, so it is not used. Agency 'Tennessee Division of Forestry' is inferred from the scope of the 2014 TDF document. Web searches used: 2.
